name: PA tracker canonical lifecycle
description: Canonical prior authorization case lifecycle for the Formulary Finder PA tracker research preview. Fully synthetic operating model; clock values cite public rules where a rule exists.

stages.label: Intake
stages.description: A new PA request is captured: medication family, plan family, and benefit type are recorded before any evidence work begins.

stages.label: Evidence assembly
stages.description: Chart-supported clinical justification is collected and organized against what the plan family is known to request.

stages.label: Submitted
stages.description: The PA packet has been sent to the payer. The standard decision clock is running.

stages.label: Acknowledged
stages.description: The payer has confirmed receipt and issued a reference number. Silence after acknowledgment is still tracked against the clock.

stages.label: Pending more info
stages.description: The payer requested additional information. The response deadline is tracked as a hard follow-up date; unconfirmed is not a denial.

stages.label: Approved
stages.description: Synthetic outcome stage: the payer authorized the request for a bounded period. Expiry tracking starts here.

stages.label: Denied
stages.description: Synthetic outcome stage: the payer declined the request as submitted. Appeal windows and reasons are recorded for the loop-closure step.

stages.label: Appeal or peer-to-peer
stages.description: A denial is being contested through appeal or peer-to-peer review while the case stays visible on the board.

stages.label: Filled
stages.description: The medication was dispensed under the authorization. The case remains open for renewal monitoring.

stages.label: Renewal due
stages.description: The authorization is approaching expiry and a renewal packet must enter the cycle before coverage lapses between visits.

sourceNotes: Standard 7 calendar day and expedited 72 hour prior authorization decision timeframes are requirements of the CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization Support final rule (CMS-0057-F), applicable to covered payers starting January 1, 2026.
default_pend_response_days and renewal_runway_days are internal synthetic-clinic operating defaults for the research preview, not regulatory figures.
